text:
cheng: Quick sync — planning to enable a contract-gated feature flag for AcmeCorp (tenant_id=acme-prod) tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Goal: gate by contract line item, small canary, clear rollback guardrails. Anyone on objections?

anika: +1 but quick q — where will the tenant allowlist live? ff-service or customer-service?

liam: I can own the PR. My vote is ff-service with a contract_id field so we can reuse for other customers. Will add server-side validation that the contract has the feature in the contract DB.

maria: Please add an SRE runbook snippet for manual disable and emergency contact. Put a breakglass toggle that only infra oncall can hit. Also add an audit tag so CSM can see it in logs.

cheng: Agreed. Proposed rollout plan: 1) Create flag: acme_contract_gated_feature (boolean) scoped to tenant 2) Canary 1: enable for 5% of Acme users for 15m 3) If no regression, ramp to 25% for 30m 4) Full enable for Acme after metrics check. Auto-rollback if error rate delta > 0.5% or p50 latency increases > 40ms for 10m.

liam: I'll open the feature-flag PR and the canary config. Example payload for ff-service API:

```json
{
  "flag_key": "acme_contract_gated_feature",
  "scope": { "type": "tenant", "id": "acme-prod" },
  "contract_id": "ACME-2025-PLAT",
  "canary": { "phase": 1, "percent": 5, "duration_minutes": 15 },
  "rollbacks": { "error_rate_threshold_pct": 0.5, "latency_ms_threshold": 40 }
}
```

anika: That looks good. One more: ensure we set enable_by_default=false for all other tenants. Also require feature flag annotation with contract clause id.

maria: For the runbook: add steps to: 1) check /metrics/flags/ACME (p50, p95, 5xx) 2) if triggered, call ops-bot: /ops disable-flag acme_contract_gated_feature tenant=acme-prod 3) notify CSM + legal. I'll draft it and attach.

ops-bot: CI pipeline started for branch liam/acme-contract-flag (build #4823).

cheng: liam when you open PR ping @cheng and @maria. Also add a migration that marks the contract feature eligibility; we should fail closed for any tenant with missing contract metadata.

liam: will do. PR template includes feature owner, SLO checks, and roll-forward checklist. ETA: PR today EOD.

ops-bot: Canary job scheduled: acme_contract_gated_feature canary #12 -> starts 2023-11-02T09:30:00Z (automation). Monitoring hooks: alert if 5xx delta > 0.5% for 10m.

maria: added emergency contact block to runbook and pinned draft in #runbooks. Also requested that the breakglass endpoint requires two-person auth for this tenant (ops + eng).

infra-bot: Deployed canary config to ff-service staging, health checks green.

cheng: Solid. If no blockers by 08:30 UTC tomorrow I'll sign off and liam can trigger the canary. Thanks — keep thread for updates. :)
